title: RBACv2 transition convergence and observability checklist
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Execute a staged migration from RBAC v1 to RBAC v2 with automated backfills, dual-write for a convergence window, and an auditable cutover that preserves admin controls and SSO mappings. This ticket owns the orchestration checklist and the observability/telemetry gating needed to safely promote canaries and then roll out to 100% of customers.

Scope: incremental backfill jobs (roles, bindings, grants), dual-write adapters in auth API, SSO/SAML attribute harmonization, audit-log continuity (schema mapping and replay), admin UI feature-flag gating, and post-cutover reconciliation.

Non-goals: model changes to role semantics beyond mapping rules defined here; long-term role normalization (separate follow-up).
updates: 2026-02-12: Kickoff meeting with PM, Security, and Design. Agreed on canary cohort size 2% and 3-week convergence window.
2026-02-18: Dual-write adapter prototype merged (PR #r-infra/2245). Adapter includes idempotency keys for backfill jobs.
2026-02-25: Audit log schema mapping doc accepted by Security. Added replay script to translate v1 actions to v2 canonical events.
2026-03-02: Telemetry plan reviewed — dashboards created for role divergence, auth-deny spikes, and admin-perm drift (console link in attachments).

2026-03-05: Discovered performance regression in an RBAC lookup hot path at 95th percentile for long role chains. Mitigation: cache short-lived role expansion results and limit backfill concurrency. Engineering estimate +2 days.
2026-03-09: Customer comms draft sent to Legal for review. Agreed on 48-hour maintenance window option for customers with strict compliance needs.
2026-03-12: Canary cutover started for cohort A (internal + opt-in customers). Early metrics look stable; role divergence <0.05% after 6h. Continuing monitoring.
2026-03-12: Next steps: finalize rollback playbook, add synthetic acceptance tests for SSO mapping, schedule post-cutover reconciliation job at +48h.
qa_steps: 1) Run synthetic auth flows for 1000 generated user+role combinations and compare allow/deny between v1 and v2
2) Validate SSO/SAML inbound mappings for three IdPs (Okta, AzureAD, Google) using test orgs
3) Exercise admin UI with feature flag on/off and verify no admin-perm elevation occurs
4) Run audit-log replay on a staging snapshot and assert event counts and critical fields match within tolerance
rollback_criteria: Sustained auth-deny rate > 0.5% above baseline for 60 minutes
Role divergence > 1% across active sessions after 2h
Critical admin account failure (unable to modify ownership/restore) observed in production
Unresolved P0 bug in dual-write adapter causing data loss
